desc: Verify characterization: feasible iff no white cell is weakly northwest (x_w ≤ x_b and y_w ≤ y_b) of a black cell; necessity from prefix monotonicity, sufficiency via downset construction. Validated against samples 1–2.

Design sweep: sort events by x ascending, W before B at same x (handles equal-row case since y_w ≤ y_b with same x is a violation; equal-column case covered by x_w ≤ x_b with strict y), maintain running min of W y-coordinates, flag B if min ≤ y_b.
Confirm complexity O(M log M) works for M ≤ 2e5, N ≤ 1e9 (Python ints fine).
Write final Python solution reading stdin, printing Yes/No, with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), early exit on violation.
